notes: Two spine branches meet in s17: thickness/compression -> SCF orientation -> lambda(thickness), and GB@rGO -> gap placement + rGO coating -> lambda(content). Audits: o3 detached rGO flakes vs 'no separation'; o5 FTIR C=O/O-H still labelled on GB@rGO vs 'disappear'; o15 1-wt% optimum absent at 0.4 mm; o25 sigma and lambda do not co-vary at 2-4 wt% (qualifies electron-dominated conduction). F5/F6 do not resolve network disruption at 2-6 wt% or bubbles in gaps (Fig. 6b). Measurement direction of lambda is not stated while SCFs lie in-plane (F6c heat flow drawn in-plane); a through-plane TIM claim would need it. F7c: lambda drops ~17% at 100 C each cycle. F7d x axis 'Thickness (mm)' 0-80 is implausible. Zeta potentials, rho/Cp, Table S1-S3, Fig. S1-S11 not in packet.
